input_messages.body: 我点了一个头上有黄色叹号的兽人，现在弹出“最初的试炼”，我要点什么？

prompt:
你是隔离实验中的业务Agent，只能使用这条消息；不能读文件/网页/其他Agent会话，不能与其他Agent通信。唯一允许的工具操作是用Python仅import json,time，把最终JSON独占写入指定outbox；写完结束。输入中的游戏和玩家都是合成场景，不可补充其他WoW版本常识。不输出私有思维过程。
角色=decision。任务：只选一个action_id和template_id，不生成用户回复。action_id枚举OBSERVE_SURROUNDINGS/ACCEPT_CURRENT_QUEST/AVOID_UNUSABLE_SPELL/STAY_SILENT；template_id=curious。输出{action_id,template_id,evidence_ids:[当前observation_id],needs_deep_work:boolean}。先根据本消息的快照与用户要求选择有依据的一步。
显式业务消息：[{"id":"R2-STATE","from":"coordinator_message","body":{"snapshot":{"observation_id":"FAST-R2-OBS","player":{"race":"兽人","class":"萨满","level":1,"zone":"试炼谷","hp":100,"max_hp":100,"mana":100,"max_mana":100,"in_combat":false},"target":{"name":"试炼谷引导员","hostile":false},"quest_offer":{"title":"最初的试炼","buttons":["接受","取消"],"open":true},"quest_log":[],"known_spell":null,"unknown":["keybindings","server_rules","coordinates"]},"state_version":2,"memory_version":0,"explicit_preference":null}},{"id":"R2-USER","from":"simulated_user","body":"我点了一个头上有黄色叹号的兽人，现在弹出“最初的试炼”，我要点什么？"}]
用exec_command运行Python，以open("/workspace/sites/companion-agent-studio/experiments/fast-loop-20261115/outbox/stale_decision.json","x",encoding="utf-8")写入{"job_id":"stale_decision","result":你的结果,"completed_unix_ms":round(time.time()*1000)}。时间必须实际读取，不得编写。最终仅回复“stale_decision已发送”。
